AS JSONB) placeholders, Oracle JSON CLOB writes use character streams, Outbox/Audit/Activation share the same binding contract, and Persistence validation blocks direct structured-JSON bindings that can regress to VARCHAR semantics.

Deployment-boundary and Workers composition alpha.0.29: Docker/Compose deployment assets are removed from canonical product source, CI and release metadata and guarded against reintroduction; a separate ignored developer workspace is supported, while Server now owns explicit MEMORY/PostgreSQL/Oracle TaskStore selection, immutable handler registry, scheduler, bounded retry policy and Spring-managed TaskWorkerPool lifecycle.

Developer Docker relocation alpha.0.30: Docker Desktop/Compose tooling is tracked at repository-root docker/ rather than below src/ or in a detached companion bundle; Server and PostgreSQL tooling Dockerfiles, fail-closed backup/restore/rollback scripts, Windows/WSL launchers and Make compose commands are included while production deployment remains standalone bare-metal/VM.

Docker PostgreSQL portability repair alpha.0.31: psql migration/rollback control files use byte-exact printf rendering instead of implementation-defined echo backslash handling, root compose.yaml includes the canonical docker/ model for direct repository-root commands, and service-scoped log helpers prevent generated container names from being confused with Compose service names.

UUIDv7 installation identity repair alpha.0.32: PostgreSQL developer bootstrap no longer uses kernel UUIDv4 identifiers; migration 0007 safely repairs only unconsumed invalid installation identities, enforces the UUIDv7 invariant in PostgreSQL and Oracle, and JDBC reports persisted identifier corruption with column context.

Entitlements temporal precision repair alpha.0.33: PostgreSQL developer bootstrap stores installation created_at at UTC whole-second precision; migration 0008 safely normalizes only unsigned installation metadata, fails closed for fractional signed/HMAC-protected entitlement data, enforces temporal precision in PostgreSQL/Oracle, and JDBC rejects malformed persisted timestamps with column context.

Spring Clock ownership repair alpha.0.34: Entitlements and Workers keep separate UTC Clock beans, every entitlement Clock injection point is explicitly qualified, and a Spring context regression proves the entitlement exception handler resolves the correct clock when both bounded contexts are enabled.

Spring framework Clock arbitration repair alpha.0.35: a canonical UTC platformClock is the sole @Primary Clock for type-only framework integrations such as Spring Modulith Moments, while Entitlements and Workers retain explicit bounded-context qualifiers; architecture and Spring-context regressions prevent ambiguous or accidental primary Clock ownership.

PGM-02-E07 operational readiness alpha.0.37: TaskWorkerPool secret-free snapshot, truthful live-loop/fatal-failure detection, fail-closed Server readiness, fixed-cardinality Micrometer metrics and Docker smoke verification of Workers readiness.
